description:
Hi, I’m Hank Miller.

I spent decades climbing high-voltage utility poles, working through midnight blizzards, and navigating dangers most people never see behind the light switch. In this line of work, there is zero room for mistakes — you learn the hard rules that keep you alive, respect the invisible power of the grid, and trust the brotherhood of the trade.

On this channel, I share the untold reality of power line work — the deadly hazards, the critical safety protocols, and the real reasons behind catastrophic failures that most people don't understand until the power goes out.

Here you’ll find deep breakdowns of arc flash disasters, storm restoration secrets, high-voltage equipment mechanics, and the unwritten rules of veteran linemen.

New videos uploaded regularly.

Subscribe if you want to see the dangerous world keeping the modern grid alive.
